question: Does the Q1-FE weak objective add future-field benefit beyond the same 64-parameter observed-prefix adaptation?
hypothesis: Across a deterministic 4/4/4 train panel, observed+FE adaptation will outperform observed-only adaptation while preserving nonworse, family, trust, and runtime behavior.

panel.selection: first four manifest positions in each family block; fixed before paired future metrics
panel.scope: parent-fit train records, mechanism attribution only; not generalization evidence

sealing: For each record both paired candidates are serialized and SHA256 hashed before future target frames 8:64 are read.

gates.family_gate: FE arm mean relative L2 <= observed-only in uniform, layered, and marmousi
gates.failure_signal: Reject the Q1-FE term if any gate fails; observed-only adaptation may remain a separate direction.

rollback: additive train-only paired diagnostic; parent and protected checkpoints remain read-only
claim_scope: A pass retains the FE weak term for a fresh group-disjoint train pilot. A fail removes FE from the adaptation objective.
